profile.name: Utkarsh Pratap
profile.title: Full Stack & Software Engineer
profile.headline: Full-stack developer experienced in building scalable web applications with Node.js, Spring Boot, Express.js, React.js, MongoDB, SQL, and REST APIs.
profile.bio: Full-stack developer experienced in building scalable web applications with Node.js, Spring Boot, Express.js, React.js, MongoDB, SQL, REST APIs, leveraging AI-assisted development tools to boost engineering productivity. Skilled in secure authentication, database optimization, microservices, RabbitMQ, CI/CD deployment on cloud platforms. GSSoC Open Source Contributor with a strong DSA foundation (800+ problems solved) and proven delivery in Agile, collaborative team environments.

education.institution: Indian Institute of Information Technology Ranchi
education.description: Coursework: Data Structures & Algorithms, OOP, Operating Systems, System Design Fundamentals, Database Management Systems, Web Development.

highlights: Developed and maintained scalable RESTful APIs using Node.js, Express.js, and SQL, following modular architecture principles to support core business functionalities and data workflows.

Implemented secure JWT-based authentication and authorization, integrated third-party services, and incorporated robust request validation and error handling to enhance application security and reliability.
Designed and optimized complex SQL queries and database operations, improving data retrieval efficiency and supporting reporting and analytics requirements across multiple modules.
Collaborated with frontend developers to integrate REST APIs, participated in Git-based development workflows, and contributed to feature delivery within an Agile development environment.

projects.title: QuickPay Payment System
projects.description: Engineered a Spring Boot backend supporting P2P (peer-to-peer) money transfers designed for scale with sub-2s real-time alerts.
highlights: Developed a Spring Boot backend supporting P2P (peer-to-peer) money transfers, engineered to reliably handle transactions at scale.
Integrated RabbitMQ for real-time transaction alerts with sub-2s latency, enabling instant user notifications.
Optimized backend REST APIs and database interactions to support scalable, high-throughput transaction processing.
Designed transaction history and mini-statement features to improve transparency and strengthen user trust.

projects.title: Civic Pulse
projects.description: Architected a React.js/Node.js civic reporting platform featuring JWT-based RBAC, Cloudinary image upload, and event-driven SMTP notifications with 99% latency reduction.
highlights: Architected a React.js/Node.js civic reporting platform; implemented JWT-based RBAC, integrated Cloudinary image uploads, and optimized MongoDB queries through indexing across a responsive TailwindCSS interface.
Engineered an event-driven architecture using RabbitMQ for asynchronous SMTP dispatch, reducing API latency by 99%; authored REST API unit tests to guarantee reliability.

Established automated deployment workflows on Vercel and Render; structured decoupled producer-consumer workers with API idempotency, achieving 100% prevention of duplicate reports during network degradation.

projects.title: MicroGig Marketplace
projects.description: Built a 5-stage gig lifecycle marketplace with role-based dashboards, Razorpay HMAC payments, and Gemini AI auto-generated gig descriptions.
highlights: Architected a full-stack freelancer marketplace using React.js frontend and Node.js/Express.js backend with MongoDB schema design supporting freelancer-client workflows, role-based dashboards, and JWT-based authentication with secure session middleware.

Engineered a 5-stage gig lifecycle state machine (Open→In Progress→Review→Accepted→Completed) with modular REST API endpoints, a notification service, and Razorpay HMAC payment verification for end-to-end transactional integrity.

Built responsive frontend with reusable React components and TailwindCSS; integrated the Gemini API to enable recruiters to auto-generate gig descriptions from structured inputs and applied Git version control across the collaborative development workflow.
